 Press Releases

  • Invitation to SEMICON 2026 & Introduction to our R (20260903)

    Dear Scientist,   
     
    Greetings and wishes.  
     
    We wish to introduce ourselves as an Engineering Consultants, trade facilitators and representatives for international manufacturers, mainly for Instruments and Equipments, etc., primarily required in advanced R&D.  

     

    Invitation for SEMICON 2026

    We wish to inform you that we are participating in SEMICON 2026, to be held from 17 – 19 September, 2026 at Yashobhoomi Expo Centre, New Delhi. We request you to visit our  Booth No. H4922, Hall No. 2 and eagerly looking forward to your visit. 

    Further we request you to forward this email to your colleagues / Phd Students, who might be interested.  

     

    Our Product profile: 

    Photomasks:    

    We supply various types of Photomasks made of Quartz, Sodalime, Polymer with lowest Critical Dimensions with lowest tolerance levels. Related products include Calibration Charts, etc.

    Please visit https://adepth.in/photomask.html

     

    Advanced Tabletop Laser Direct Imager

    Our high-end Laser Direct Imager (LDI) deliver exceptional resolution and throughput for demanding semiconductor and research applications.

    Applications covering, Semiconductor / Microelectronics / HDI / MEMS / PCB ,Material Science, 2D Materials and Quantum devices, Lab-on-a-Chip device, Microfluidics, Biosensor / Wearable Health Monitors, etc.

    Please visit https://adepth.in/laser-direct-imager.html

     

    2D Material Detection and Transfer System

    2D Material Detection System, is an automated tool that uses computer vision, machine learning, and optical microscopy to find, classify, and map atomically thin flakes like graphene and transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs). They measure less than a micrometer thick vertically, existing as flat, sheet-like layers.

    Please visit https://adepth.in/2D-material-detection-and-transfer-system.html

     

    Optical Tweezer Systems

    A cutting-edge optical tweezer system designed to deliver high precision and accuracy. Ideal for researchers across various fields, this complete turn-key device is fully compatible with Nikon inverted microscopes, thus adding contactless manipulation and force measurements to the existing standard and advanced microscopy techniques. Tweez uses Acousto-Optic laser beam Deflector technology (AOD) to simultaneously achieve high speed and sub-nanometre precision.

    Applications covering, Quantum Research, Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, Biophysics, Soft Matter Physics, Microrheology, Nanotechnology, Microfluidics, Drug Discovery, etc.

    Please visit https://adepth.in/optical-tweezer.html

     

    Microfluidics Station

    Our Microfluidic workstation is an automated lab system used to handle incredibly tiny amounts of liquid (measured in Microliters / Nanoliters / Picoliters) for scientific research.

    Applications covering, Single-Cell Cultivation and Analysis, DNA chain stretching, Genomic Analysis, Regenerative medicine, Lab-on-a-chip, Point-of-Care Diagnostics, Drug Discovery, Delivery & Development, etc.

    Please visit https://adepth.in/microfluidic.html

     

    Fuel Cell Test Station – Hydrogen generators -

    Our high tech stations with power ranging from 100 W to 250 kW. They are of High Temperature and Low Temperature Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell (PEM FC) test stations for testing FC Stacks.  

    Hydrogen generators - Water Electrolyzer

    Our generators are designed for continuous hydrogen production with high Quality of produced Hydrogen, long life time, small space requirement and high efficiency.

    Please visit  https://adepth.in/fuel-cell.html

     

    The details given above and our website are indicative only. We are available for further detailed discussions.

    Eagerly looking forward to receive your R&D requirements.


    Thanks & warm regards,
